title: Local expected satisfaction indicator
statement: Let $D$ be a finite label set, let a constraint apply a specified predicate to an ordered tuple of distinct variables, and assign to each variable a probability distribution on $D$. The local expected satisfaction indicator is the probability that the predicate accepts when the labels at the variables in the constraint’s scope are drawn independently according to their assigned distributions.
hypotheses_covered: A constraint with its specified predicate and scope
A probability distribution on $D$ for each variable
